findings.issue_category: missing key policy / overly permissive default
findings.description: No key_policy is defined, so the key uses the default KMS policy which grants the entire AWS account (via IAM) full access to the key through 'kms:*' for root, relying solely on IAM policies for access control. For a sensitive audit trail key this is overly permissive since any IAM principal with broad IAM permissions could manage or use the key without explicit scoped restriction, undermining separation of duties.
The resource does not set enable_key_rotation = true, so automatic key rotation is disabled by default, weakening cryptographic hygiene for a key protecting audit trail data.
